page.title: Access tokens
page.description: Tokens that let CI and lode clients reach your packages.

table.empty: No tokens yet. Create one to let CI or an operator host reach your packages.

editor.allNote: One level for every package in your namespace. It also covers packages you create later.
editor.noPackagesLink: Create one on the Packages page
editor.emptyWarning: No package is selected. You can still create or save the token, but it will reach no package.

legend.title: Access levels
legend.read: Fetch the manifest and assets of a private package and read its metadata. This is what an operator host needs.
legend.write: Release: create drafts, upload assets, publish and move channels. Also register signing keys, so a pipeline can add its own public key.
legend.admin: Change package settings, yank and restore versions.
legend.inclusive: Each level includes the ones before it.

limits.title: What no token can do
limits.body: Whatever its grants, a token can never create or delete packages, delete published versions, revoke signing keys, manage tokens, change quota or administer the platform.
limits.session: These actions need a signed-in session.

create.title: New access token
create.description: Choose which packages the token may reach and how far.

secret.title: Token {{name}} created
secret.description: Store the secret in your CI or on the host that needs it.
secret.warning: Copy the token now. It will not be shown again, and closing this dialog discards it.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.description: The secret stays the same: clients that already use this token keep working with the new access. Expiry cannot be changed.

revoke.title: Revoke this token?
revoke.description: {{name}} stops working immediately for every client that uses it. This cannot be undone.
